annotations.title: Generate an llms.txt file for a website

description: Reads a website's homepage, navigation and sitemap, then writes an llms.txt file (the markdown summary some AI tools read) that the owner can upload to the site root. Use it when someone wants their site understood or cited by ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity. Returns the file content.
name: generate_llms_txt
title: Generate an llms.txt file for a website
